sentences.text: Hon'Ble Smt. Justice G. Anupama Chakravarthy

Criminal Petition Nos.
 1128 and 1625 of 2014
Common Order :

Criminal Petition No.1128 of 2014 is filed for quashing FIR.No.23 of 2014 of P.S. Abid Road,
Hyderabad, registered for the offences under Sections 406, 409 and 420 of IPC, whereas, Criminal Petition No.1625 of 2014 is filed for quashing FIR.No.35 of 2014 of P.S.Charminar, registered for the offences under Sections 403 and 409 of IPC.

2. Since the subject matter in both the aforesaid FIRs. relate to the Wakf Board, both these petitions are heard together and are disposed of by this common order.
3.
Heard learned counsel for petitioner and the learned Standing Counsel for the Wakf Board.
Perused the record.
4. The allegations levelled against the petitioner are that he was the Ex-Managing Trustee and Mutawalli of the Wakf Institutions, namely, Macca Madina Alladin Wakf and its allied institutions.
It GAC, J Crl.P.Nos.1128 & 1625 of 2014 is alleged that the petitioner has failed to handover the assets, account books and ledgers pertaining to such Wakf institutions.
5. It is stated in the reports that the sole object of the Wakf is to help the inhabitants of holy places of Mecca, Madina and Jeddah and also to help poor people of Iraq.

On account of serious charges of mismanagement, misappropriation, failure to submit budgetary statement, failure to bring into the knowledge of the Wakf Board about change in the management, failure to place the record showing the income which is in lakhs, failure to conduct meeting and failure to fulfill the object of the Wakf,
carried out constructions without any prior permission from the Wakf Board, an inquiry was initiated against the Ex-Managing Trustee i.e. the petitioner herein.

It is also alleged in the reports that during the inquiry, the petitioner has failed to submit the record relating to disbursement of amount, though as pleaded by the petitioner himself, the income was more than Rs.50,000/- per annum, thus, the petitioner herein has misappropriated the amount, therefore, is liable for punishment.
GAC, J Crl.P.Nos.1128 & 1625 of 2014 6.
After filing these petitions, this Court granted interim stay of investigation in both the crimes and the same is pending since 2014.

sentences.text:
relating to the Wakf Board, the petitioner has filed O.A.No.4 of 2012 before the Wakf Tribunal,
which is pending for the past Decade.

It is contended that during the pendency of the above O.A.,
the present frivolous reports are filed against the petitioner, only with an intent to tarnish the image of the petitioner and his family members, who are working for upliftment of the poor.
It is further contended that some people, who are trying to construct a new commercial complex for their benefit, have filed the present reports making false allegations against the petitioner.

Accordingly,
he prayed to quash both the FIRs.

It is further contended by the learned counsel for petitioner that with the same set of facts, two reports were given by the Wakf Board, in two Police stations, namely,
Abid Road and Charminar, and as such, one petition has to be quashed even without going into merits.
GAC, J Crl.P.Nos.1128 & 1625 of 2014 8.

On the other hand, it is contended by the learned Standing Counsel for the Wakf Board that the petitioner has misappropriated huge amounts, and therefore, it is a fit case to be investigated by the Police.
9.
The learned Standing Counsel took time thrice for filing counter, but no counter affidavit is filed.
10. On perusal of the record, it is evident that the petitioner has preferred O.A.No.4 of 2012 before the Wakf Tribunal.

There is not even a single document before this Court, except the FIRs., to see whether prima facie case is made out for the offences punishable under Sections 403, 406, 409 or 420 of IPC.
11.
Admittedly, the petitioner was the Managing Trustee of the Macca Madina Alladin Wakf Institution and its allied institutions.
Further, his grandfather was the founder of the said institutions.
It is the specific contention of the petitioner before the Court that his best endeavour is to help the needy persons and that the complainant is not authorized to lodge report under the Wakf Act.
GAC, J Crl.P.Nos.1128 & 1625 of 2014
Even a bare reading of the reports also do not reveal as to how much amount has been misappropriated and as to what is the breach of trust committed by the petitioner herein.
No specific instances have been mentioned in the reports so as to investigate the matter.
As the matter is being tried before the Wakf Tribunal, this Court is of the considered view that there is no necessity for the Police to investigate into the same matter.
12. For the aforesaid reasons, both these criminal petitions are allowed.
Consequently, both the FIRs. registered against the petitioner i.e. FIR.No.23 of 2014 of P.S. Abid Road and FIR.No.35 of 2014 of P.S. Charminar, are hereby quashed.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.

G.ANUPAMA CHAKRAVARTHY, J Date:
